# Lazee.dev

> Lazee.dev is an AI-powered browser extension and developer platform that autofills job applications 100x faster, drafts personalized recruiter cold outreach, and manages career assets. Stop typing, start applying.

## About

Lazee.dev is a developer-centric productivity tool built for software engineers, developers, and tech job seekers who want to eliminate the repetitive friction of manually filling out job applications. It pairs a lightweight cross-browser extension (v2.2.3 for Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Microsoft Edge, and Brave) with a comprehensive web platform for career profile management, multi-resume hosting, custom AI provider orchestration, and shareable public portfolios.

- Website: https://lazee.dev
- Tagline: "Stop Typing. Start Applying."
- Extension Version: v2.2.3
- Category: Developer Tools / Job Search Automation / AI Productivity / Career OS
- Status: Launched & Active
- Product Hunt: https://www.producthunt.com/products/lazee-dev
- Peerlist: https://peerlist.io/tusharsoni014/project/lazeedev--job-applications-100x-faster
- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/lazeedev-ai-job-autofill-cold-dm/hkompooiicoamiambpjhbbmimjefgiii
- Firefox Add-ons: https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/lazeedev/

## The Problem

Job applications in tech are painfully repetitive and fragmented. Engineers spend 4+ minutes per job application manually re-entering the exact same information — contact details, CTC / compensation breakdown, notice period, work experience, education, portfolio links, and answering open-ended recruiter prompts ("Why do you want to join us?", "Describe a difficult bug you fixed"). Across 20–50 applications, that wastes hours of valuable engineering time on mindless data entry.

## The Solution

Lazee.dev reduces application time from ~4 minutes to under 10 seconds per job. Profile details are stored once and automatically mapped into application fields. For open-ended questions, Lazee provides instant, context-aware AI answers tailored to the candidate's actual background and the target job description. With Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) support, users can run AI answers through OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Grok, or local models (Ollama / LM Studio) completely free of Lazee credits.

---

## Core Features

### 1. Smart Form Auto-Fill (Free, Unlimited Forever)
- Automatically detects input fields, textareas, dropdowns, and radio buttons across 100+ hiring platforms and custom career pages.
- Deterministically maps candidate data: personal details, contact info, job preferences, CTC, notice period, work experience, education, skills, and portfolio links.
- Non-AI basic autofill is 100% free and unlimited forever.
- Injects a clean, non-intrusive interactive trigger directly on active form elements.
- Features a quick-access Profile Data overlay: click any profile field to fill the active input, or Shift+click to copy it to clipboard.

### 2. Bring Your Own AI / Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)
- Available to both Free (Community) and Pro users.
- Connect your own API keys or local models to power extension AI features with **0 Lazee credits spent**:
  - **OpenAI (ChatGPT)**: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, o1, o3-mini, and compatible chat models.
  - **Anthropic (Claude)**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, and Claude Opus models.
  - **Google Gemini**: Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Gemini 1.5 Flash, etc.
  - **xAI (Grok)**: Grok 2, Grok Beta, and compatible endpoints.
  - **Custom & Local Models**: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including **Ollama** (`http://localhost:11434/v1`) and **LM Studio** (`http://localhost:1234/v1`) running on your own machine, as well as OpenRouter or self-hosted vLLM servers.
- **Local-First Privacy Architecture**: Your API keys and endpoint configurations are stored exclusively in your browser's local extension storage (`browser.storage.local`). Keys are never sent to, proxied through, or stored on Lazee servers.
- **Direct Browser Inference**: The extension makes direct API calls from the background service worker using extension host permissions (`*://*/*`), avoiding CORS restrictions and eliminating server middleware.
- **Provider & Model Switcher**: Switch active providers and discover available models with real-time latency checks directly inside the extension popup and on the web dashboard (`/profile/ai-providers`).

### 3. Target Job Description (JD) Intelligence & URL-Keyed Storage
- Paste the target job posting or role requirements directly into the extension modal (AI Fill or Cold DM tabs).
- **Smart URL-Keyed Persistence**: The extension strips tracking parameters (UTM parameters, gclid, ref, etc.) and automatically caches the job description tied to the job post's canonical URL (stores up to 100 recent job descriptions in local extension storage).
- When filling multiple open-ended questions on the same job application or revisiting the page later, the stored job description is automatically retrieved and applied.
- **Deep Context Alignment**: Generates responses that directly match the employer's specific tech stack, required qualifications, and role keywords with the candidate's actual projects and experience.
- Costs +6 credits when using Lazee AI (total 8 credits per generation), or **0 credits** when using BYOK.

### 4. AI-Powered Single-Question Answer Synthesis (AI Fill)
- Synthesizes professional, context-rich responses for custom, open-ended application questions (e.g., "Why are you interested in this role?", "Explain your architectural decisions on a recent project").
- Follows exact formatting requirements requested by the form (word counts, bullet points, fixed/variable/ESOPs breakdown, and automatic currency conversion).
- Custom prompt steering box: Provide optional real-time instructions to steer tone, length, or emphasis.
- First-person perspective guarantee: Strictly speaks as the candidate ("I", "my", "me") with no generic AI disclaimers or third-person phrasing.
- One-click actions: Insert answer into the active field, copy to clipboard, or save directly into your Saved Q&A library.
- Costs 2 credits per field with Lazee AI, or 0 credits with BYOK.

### 5. 1-Click Express AI Fill (Pro Feature)
- Batch-processes entire job application forms in seconds.
- Automatically scans the current web page, detects every form field (text inputs, number fields, textareas), categorizes field types, and displays an interactive checklist modal.
- Select or deselect which specific fields you want the AI to answer.
- Upfront credit estimate: Transparently displays required credit cost before generating, or indicates 0 credits when using BYOK.
- Concurrently synthesizes personalized answers for all selected questions and fills the entire form with a single click.

### 6. Saved Questions & Answers Library (Saved Q&A)
- "Write it once. Reuse it on every application."
- Comprehensive Q&A repository for recurring application prompts ("Tell me about yourself", "Greatest technical challenge", "Why are you leaving your current role?").
- Accessible both in the browser extension and on the web dashboard (`/profile/saved-questions` and `/saved-questions`).
- In-Extension Saved Q&A tab:
  - Instant client-side search across question titles and answer contents.
  - 1-click insert directly into the active form field.
  - 1-click copy to clipboard.
  - In-modal "Add New" form to save new Q&A pairs on the fly.
  - In-modal "Save to Library" button directly inside the AI Fill window to immediately preserve high-quality generated answers.
- Web dashboard allows full CRUD operations: add, edit, search, copy, and delete saved answers.

### 7. AI Cold DM & Recruiter Outreach Generator (Pro Feature)
- Dedicated outreach generator integrated directly into Gmail compose (`mail.google.com`) and available across application portals.
- Ingests recipient info, company/founder background, and target job description to draft highly personalized outreach.
- In-page web scraper pulls company and job details to inform the outreach context.
- Supports multiple outreach intents (Job Application, Networking, Referral Request).
- 4 tailored communication tones:
  - **Professional**: Polished, structured, metric-driven.
  - **Casual**: Conversational, approachable, clear.
  - **Friendly**: Warm, enthusiastic, collaborative.
  - **Gen Z**: Snappy, direct, personality-forward, jargon-free.
- Costs 2 credits (or 8 credits with JD) with Lazee AI, or 0 credits with BYOK (requires Pro membership).

### 8. Multi-Resume Management & PDF Resume Autofill
- Upload and organize multiple resume PDF variants (e.g., Frontend-focused, Backend / Distributed Systems, Fullstack, AI/ML).
- Free plan includes 1 Resume PDF; Pro plan supports up to 10 resume variants.
- Instant popup switcher: Select the active resume directly from the extension before applying.
- Deterministic ATS file upload matching attaches the chosen resume PDF to the form's file upload field.
- **Resume Autofill Upload**: Upload a PDF resume on the dashboard (`/profile`) to automatically parse and populate profile fields (work experience, education, skills, contact info) with 1 click.
- Cloud storage backed by Cloudflare R2 (S3-compatible) with secure asset delivery.

### 9. Public Developer Portfolio Profile (`/u/[username]`)
- Claim a custom username for a shareable public portfolio link (`lazee.dev/u/yourusername`).
- Clean, fast, responsive showcase designed as a recruiter portal:
  - Bio, headline, target role, notice period, and availability status.
  - Verified contact information & social links (LinkedIn, GitHub, X, Telegram, Portfolio).
  - Categorized skills matrix.
  - Chronological work experience with role descriptions and achievements.
  - Education history.
  - Featured projects showcase with live demo links, GitHub repositories, tech stack badges, and screenshots.
  - Direct 1-click download of the primary resume PDF.
  - Embedded video introduction support.

## Supported Job Boards & ATS Platforms

Lazee.dev supports 100+ hiring platforms, applicant tracking systems (ATS), and custom career pages:

- **Greenhouse** (`greenhouse.io`, `boards.greenhouse.io`)
- **Lever** (`lever.co`, `jobs.lever.co`)
- **Ashby** (`ashbyhq.com`)
- **SmartRecruiters** (`smartrecruiters.com`)
- **Wellfound / AngelList** (`wellfound.com`, `angel.co`)
- **Y Combinator / Work at a Startup** (`workatastartup.com`, `ycombinator.com`)
- **Glassdoor** (`glassdoor.com`, `glassdoor.co.in`)
- **Superteam Talent** (`talent.superteam.fun`)
- **ClanX** (`jobs.clanx.ai`)
- **Google Forms** (`docs.google.com/forms`, `forms.gle`, `forms.google.com`)
- **Notion Career Pages** (`notion.site`, `notion.so`)
- **Airtable Forms** (`airtable.com`)
- **Tally Forms** (`tally.so`, `tally.co`)
- **Gmail Compose** (`mail.google.com`)
- **Universal Form Detection**: Smart heuristic engine that inspects DOM hierarchies, input labels, aria attributes, and placeholders to autofill custom company career portals and standalone HTML forms.
- **Built-in Non-Job Board Blocklist**: Automatically silences autofill triggers on non-hiring domains (social media, search engines, developer dashboards, productivity suites) to eliminate unwanted UI popups.
- **Domain Toggle Switch**: Manually enable or disable extension monitoring per website or domain directly from the popup.

---

## Profile Data You Can Store

Lazee.dev provides an exhaustive career profile database to back your applications:

- **Personal Information**: First name, middle name, last name, gender, postal code.
- **Equal Opportunity / Demographics (Optional)**: Veteran status, disability status.
- **Contact Information**: Primary email, contact email, country code, phone number, city, country.
- **Career & Compensation Preferences**: Target job role/type, notice period (in days), current CTC, expected CTC, currency selection.
- **Work Experience**: Company name, role title, location, company website, start/end dates, current role flag, and detailed achievements.
- **Education**: School/university name, degree, field of study, start/end dates, current enrollment flag, public visibility flag, and description.
- **Projects**: Project title, role, contribution summary, duration, live demo URL, GitHub repository URL, logo URL, tech stack tags, screenshots, and top/featured project flag.
- **Skills Matrix**: Tag-based skills list covering languages, frameworks, databases, and developer tooling.
- **Multiple Resumes**: PDF uploads with primary selection and version tracking (1 on Free, up to 10 on Pro).
- **Social Profiles & Links**: LinkedIn, GitHub, Twitter/X, Portfolio, Telegram, custom social links.
- **Default Cover Letter**: Saved base cover letter template for instant insertion.
- **Custom AI Guidance Notes**: Persistent instructions telling the AI how to formulate answers on your behalf (e.g., specific achievements to highlight, tone preferences, specific role pivots).
- **Saved Q&A Pairs**: Library of reusable question-and-answer templates.

## Pricing & Credits

### Free Plan (Community) — $0/month (Free Forever)
- Unlimited basic profile data autofill forever (experience, education, projects, CTC, notice period, links).
- Universal ATS & job board support (100+ platforms + custom sites).
- **Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)**: Connect OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Grok, or local models (Ollama / LM Studio) for **0 Lazee credits** on single questions and JD alignment.
- 1 Resume PDF storage with deterministic field matching.
- 200 AI credits per month (refreshed automatically every 30 days).
- Single-question AI Fill with custom prompt steering (2 credits base, or 8 credits with JD; 0 credits with BYOK).
- Saved Q&A library with instant search, 1-click insert, and copy.
- Public developer portfolio profile (`lazee.dev/u/[username]`).

### Pro Plan — $9/month
- Everything in Free.
- **10,000 AI credits per month** (50x higher monthly allowance).
- **1-Click Express Batch Fill**: Autofill all open-ended questions on a page simultaneously.
- **AI Cold DM & Recruiter Outreach Generator**: Gmail compose integration, web scraper, and 4 communication tones.
- **Multi-Resume Matrix**: Upload and manage up to 10 resume PDF versions with instant popup hot-swapping.
- Advanced AI reasoning models for superior answer quality.
- Priority customer support and early access to new ATS integrations.

### How the Credits System Works
- Profile data autofill (name, email, phone, experience, education, links, resumes) is **100% free and unlimited** for all users.
- Single-question AI fill using Lazee AI costs **2 credits**.
- Single-question AI fill with Target Job Description attached costs **8 credits** (2 base + 6 JD).
- Cold DM generation using Lazee AI costs **2 credits** (or **8 credits** with JD).
- Express Batch Fill costs 2 credits per selected field (plus JD credits if attached).
- **When Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) is active, all AI answer generation and JD alignment cost 0 Lazee credits**.
- Free accounts receive 200 credits every 30 days. Pro accounts receive 10,000 credits every 30 days.

---

## How It Works

1. **Set Up Your Profile**: Fill in your contact info, experience, education, projects, skills, and upload resumes on [lazee.dev/profile](https://lazee.dev/profile). Optionally configure your preferred AI provider or local model at [lazee.dev/profile/ai-providers](https://lazee.dev/profile/ai-providers).
2. **Install the Extension**: Add Lazee to Chrome, Edge, Brave, or Firefox. Sign in with Google to sync your profile instantly.
3. **Apply Anywhere**: Open any job application on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, or 100+ platforms. Lazee detects form fields automatically.
4. **1-Click Autofill & AI Generation**: Basic details autofill instantly. Click the Lazee icon on open-ended questions to generate tailored answers (or use Pro Express Fill to complete the entire application in one shot).
5. **Outreach & Reuse**: Save strong answers to your Saved Q&A library for future applications, and open Gmail to generate targeted cold outreach to hiring managers.

---

## Technical Architecture & Tech Stack

### Browser Extension
- **Framework**: [WXT](https://wxt.dev/) (Next-Gen Web Extension Framework)
- **UI & Components**: React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Lucide Icons
- **Target Environments**: Chrome (MV3), Edge (MV3), Firefox (MV2 & MV3)
- **Local Storage**: `browser.storage.local` for credentials, encrypted BYOK configurations, canonical URL job description caches, and domain toggles
- **AI Client Layer**: Direct browser-to-provider streaming via background service worker (`fetch` with host permissions, zero server hops for BYOK)
- **Bundle Size**: Under 500KB (lightweight, zero browser overhead)

### Web Application & Backend
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript
- **Styling & Motion**: TailwindCSS 4, Motion (Framer Motion)
- **Authentication**: NextAuth.js v5 with Google OAuth provider
- **Database & ORM**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM
- **Cloud Storage**: Cloudflare R2 (AWS S3-compatible API) for PDF resumes and project assets
- **Billing & Subscriptions**: Dodo Payments (checkout sessions, webhook sync, customer portal)
- **Hosting**: Vercel

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is Bring Your Own AI (BYOK) and how does it work?
BYOK allows you to connect your own API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or xAI, or connect to a local LLM running on your computer via Ollama or LM Studio. When BYOK is active, the extension sends requests directly from your browser to your provider's API. The inference cost is billed directly to your provider account, which means it uses **0 Lazee credits**. Free and Pro users can both use BYOK.

### Are my API keys safe when using BYOK?
Yes. Lazee follows a local-first security model. Your API keys and endpoint URLs are saved strictly in your browser's local extension storage (`browser.storage.local`). They are never uploaded to, logged by, or proxied through Lazee servers.

### How does the Target Job Description (JD) storage feature work?
When applying for a role, you can paste the job description into the extension modal once. Lazee strips tracking URL parameters and binds that JD to the canonical job posting URL in your browser's local storage (storing up to 100 recent postings). As you fill out multiple questions on that job or return to it later, the extension remembers the job description automatically. This enables the AI to weave relevant role requirements and keywords into your answers.

### What is the difference between AI Fill and Express AI Fill?
- **AI Fill**: Injects an interactive button into individual open-ended form fields, allowing you to generate, steer with custom instructions, and review answers one at a time.
- **Express AI Fill (Pro)**: Scans the entire career page, identifies all open-ended questions, and synthesizes answers for all of them concurrently with one click.

### What is the Saved Q&A Library?
The Saved Q&A library lets you store your best answers to common job application questions (such as "Describe a technical challenge" or "Why do you want to join us?"). You can search your library directly inside the browser extension modal and insert answers into any field with 1 click, or copy them to your clipboard.

### Does basic autofill cost credits?
No. Autofilling your saved profile details (name, email, phone, location, work experience, education, projects, skills, CTC, and links) is 100% free and unlimited forever.

### Can I store and switch between multiple resumes?
Yes. Free users can store 1 primary resume PDF. Pro users can store up to 10 resume variants (e.g., specialized for Frontend, Backend, ML, or Engineering Management) and hot-swap between them directly inside the extension popup when applying.

### How do I get a shareable public portfolio?
Set a custom username in your profile settings to activate your public portfolio at `lazee.dev/u/yourusername`. It displays your verified contact info, bio, work history, skills, featured projects with live links, and primary resume download link.
